reviews.author: Vivek
reviews.text:
I had a very positive experience with the doctor and the entire team. The doctor explained my condition very clearly and made sure I understood everything before proceeding. The staff was also very friendly and supportive throughout my visits.

I have been dealing with segmental vitiligo for the past few years and had consulted many doctors, but unfortunately, I did not see good results. However, Dr. Kavya suggested blister grafting and melanocyte surgery at a reasonable cost, which gave me new hope.

After the surgery, I noticed a fast and encouraging recovery, which made a huge difference in my confidence. I am truly grateful for the care and treatment I received and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone facing similar issues.

reviews.author: Pusuluri Pujitha
reviews.text:
Leelavathi Advanced Skin Clinic offers outstanding care with modern facilities for skin and hair treatments. The clinic maintains a professional, clean, and welcoming environment, making every visit comfortable and reassuring.

I have taken around 10 sessions of laser hair removal along with freckle and mole removal treatments, and I am extremely satisfied with the results. The treatments are effective, safe, and very affordable compared to many other clinics.

Ms. Swathi, one of the staff members, is very caring, polite, and responsive. She explains everything clearly and makes sure patients feel comfortable throughout the treatment process.

A special thanks to Dr. Leelavathi Ma’am, whose expertise, patience, and dedication truly stand out. Her careful evaluation and treatment approach give great confidence and trust to every patient.

Whether it is a routine skin check or an advanced cosmetic procedure, Leelavathi Advanced Skin Clinic delivers high-quality care and excellent results. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for professional and reliable skin and hair treatments.
